manage/SessionDetailPage.tsx.why: The session's own last_error, inside a labelled field row. The row already names what the text is; a bordered note inside it frames the same thing twice.

session/components/SessionHeader.tsx.why: The session's last error under its title, truncated to one line. A box in the header band would stand taller than the band.

session/components/ToolParts.tsx.why: A tool's own stderr in a <pre>, where line breaks and spacing are the content. Wrapping it in a note would nest two boxes around one payload.
